data.description:
Pager, StatusLine and LoadingLine: the three pinned chrome pieces around the results. Spec: docs/SPEC.md §7.4, §7.5, §7.6. Design: BRANDING.md §5.3 (status line), §5.7 (pager), §5.9 (loading row), §6 (motion), §2.2 jobs 2 and 5, §7.2 strings. Reference: docs/branding-demo.html.

Why: pagination must be visible and operable (handout), the status line is where "ranked for $450,000" tells the user what the ordering means, and the loading line is the only animation in the product.

Scope (props per SPEC §7.4):
- Pager: 48px, hairline above. `‹ Previous` left and `Next ›` right as text buttons; every page number centered with 16px gaps (the dataset is small; windowing is noted in docs/EXTENSIONS.md). Current page in oxblood weight 500 with a 1px oxblood underline and `aria-current="page"`. Disabled Previous/Next in ink-3 using the `disabled` attribute so they are not focusable. Glyphs are text, not icons. Hidden entirely when totalPages is 0.
- StatusLine: Meta 13 ink-2, two halves. Left derived from SearchState with the BC-8 formatters: `12 results · ranked for $450,000`, `12 results · newest first` when scoring.targetBudget is null, `1 result` singular, `Loading` while loading, `0 results` when empty, empty on error. Right: `Page 1 of 2`, empty when there are no pages.
- LoadingLine: 2px track in line color under the filter bar; when active a 40% oxblood segment slides left to right, 1.2s linear, looping; `role="progressbar"` with an accessible name; under prefers-reduced-motion a static full-width oxblood line (§6). Inactive renders the empty track so layout never shifts.
- Tests: every StatusLine string for every state (idle, loading with and without previous, success with and without budget, empty, invalid, error); singular/plural; Pager bounds and callbacks, aria-current, disabled ends not focusable, hidden at zero pages; LoadingLine active/inactive and the reduced-motion branch.

Acceptance:
- Strings match BRANDING §5.3 and §7.2 verbatim (tests assert exact text).
- Only oxblood uses are the pager text buttons, the current page and the loading segment.
- Tests and lint green; no emoji.

Validation: N/A until BC-12. Record a one-line justification with --role validation and cite the test output.
data.title: Pager, StatusLine and LoadingLine components

data.body: Plan review art_01M4W70T5RKM712EBW3C1DRCGG PASS with 4 minors, all triaged obvious and folded into the plan (Plan-Review Cycle 1 Resolutions): (1) Pager text buttons follow BRANDING §5.8 + demo .link exactly: no tracking, hover = underline only (3px offset), no oxblood-deep; (2) LoadingLine resting track is transparent (2px box kept); line color only while active, per demo. One-line flip if the owner wants a visible grey track; (3) S10/S11 error objects built explicitly from validationErrorBody / a network ApiError; (4) CSS-source tests assert non-empty file and anchor the reduced-motion regex to .segment inside the @media block. No evolutionary or complex findings.

Code review art_01M4W7R1433RHFSG03A1HCD8BT PASS @ 0e70187. Finding routing: [minor] StatusLine.tsx:14 duplicated comment -> SKIPPED: cosmetic, reviewer marked optional/no rework cycle; fixing it would move HEAD and require a re-review for zero behavior change. Hand-off note (BRANDING §3.2/§3.3 +0.02em button tracking and §2.1 oxblood-deep hover vs §5.8/demo .link text-button recipe) -> new backlog ticket for the branding owner (builders do not edit BRANDING.md).

Completion (delegator). Built: frontend/src/components/{StatusLine,Pager,LoadingLine}/ (tsx + module.css + test, 9 new files, 667 lines, 3 commits 34271a1 8c0e891 0e70187; no other file touched, no BC-8 helper or fixture changes, no dependencies). StatusLine derives [left,right] from every SearchState arm with formatResultSummary/formatPageOf: idle ['',''], loading ['Loading', page of previous or ''], success/empty summarize(data), invalid summarize(previous) or ['',''], error ['','']; role=status. Pager: nav 'Pagination', real buttons, Previous/Next disabled via the disabled attribute, glyphs as aria-hidden text, page buttons named 'Page N' with aria-current on the current page (no-op click), past-end page: none current, Previous goes to last page, Next disabled; returns null when totalPages <= 0; never moves focus (BC-12). LoadingLine: progressbar named 'Loading' only while active, 40% oxblood segment 1.2s linear infinite, static full width under prefers-reduced-motion. LoadingLine resting track is transparent (2px box kept); line color only while active, per demo. One-line flip if the owner wants a visible grey track. Deviations: Pager onChange typed as a property (onChange: (page) => void) instead of SPEC §7.4's method form because typescript-eslint unbound-method fails on destructured method props; call shape unchanged, no SPEC edit needed. Text buttons follow BRANDING §5.8 + demo .link (no tracking, underline-only hover). Findings routed: plan review 4 minors folded into the plan; code review PASS with 1 optional cosmetic minor skipped (see earlier comment). Follow-up created: BC-19 (backlog, low) BRANDING text-button tracking/hover reconciliation. Hand-offs for BC-12: keep LoadingLine mounted under the FilterBar, move focus to the results heading after Pager onChange, query page buttons by 'Page N', StatusLine is a polite role=status region alongside the results live region. Gate: make check exit 0 (228 tests) + npm run build exit 0 at 0e70187. Validation N/A art_01M4W7T6W1CN66SDFA83DGMNDY cites the 31-test vitest output.
